reviews.title: Great power doesn't always come with great responsibility.
reviews.comment: Runs like a dream so far and barely even purrs like a kitten, running things like the isle and cyberpunk on high settings, and most other things on max/cinematic. When I saw just $40 difference between this and a 4070(? I THINK?) I went for it, and I don't regret it a bit.
reviews.author: Kindle Customer

reviews.title: Bang for the Buck
reviews.comment:
Shipping and delivery was good. Item arrived undamaged and within a reasonable amount of time.
The card looks amazing with my white setup, too. Nice and quiet, plus the built in manually switch to go from performance to quiet mode is a nice touch. I've left it on performance and it's ran much quieter than some online reviews credit it for.
As for the product itself, it was nearly packaged, and ready to use. True plug and play at its finest. So far, by the grace of the Almighty, the card has done what it was advertised in doing. Runs Cyberpunk 2077 ultra graphics with ray tracing just fine, same with Starfield at max settings. Something I'm still getting used to, to be completely honest.
The price was the selling point for me, pun intended. For this amount of quality for that price, I can comfortably and confidently recommend this card to anyone looking to upgrade, but not sweat over it.
reviews.author: Corey Edward Vernon

reviews.title: Clean look and easy to fit for any build
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/E1SgQNez9TL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/61Efm9VgQNL._SY256.jpg I have been using this GPU in my build and it has been very solid to date. The white design appears clean as hell in real life and fits well within a lighter thematic design without being flashy. On the performance side it can comfortably support 1080p and 1440p gaming with no frame rate issues on high settings. The two-fan cooler is effective in maintaining temperatures, and it remains relatively quiet, even when used in longer sessions. Its relatively small size also contributed to ease in installation particularly compared to larger triple-fan cards.
